title: A Pickaxe of the Gods
description: Pickaxe of the Gods is a Minecraft mod featuring an evolving pickaxe that grows stronger as you use it. Every block mined grants experience, allowing the pickaxe to level up and become increasingly powerful.
body:
# Pickaxe of the Gods

**Pickaxe of the Gods is a Minecraft mod centered around an evolving pickaxe that grows stronger the more you use it.**

The pickaxe gains experience every time you mine a block. As it levels up, it becomes progressively more efficient, faster, and capable of mining increasingly tougher blocks.

The progression system is designed to be long-term and rewarding, with each level requiring more mined blocks than the previous one. This turns the pickaxe into a true progression-based tool instead of just another standard pickaxe.

Pickaxe of the Gods is designed to integrate naturally into a Minecraft world while introducing a persistent progression system focused on a single unique tool.

## Crafting Recipe

![craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8755c8684f595a2af35071e467e7a30fc1b02b88.png)

## 20 Different Forms

The pickaxe changes appearance as it levels up, unlocking a total of 20 different visual forms.

![forms](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b7f80b3d2687c52e6fdfbeafed1802bde6f5d77.png)

## `/pog leaderboard`

The `/pog leaderboard` command displays the top 3 players with the highest pickaxe level on the server.

## Features

- Persistent pickaxe leveling system
- Experience gained from every mined block
- Increasing mining speed and efficiency
- Progressive long-term leveling curve
- 20 pickaxe appearances
- Multiplayer leaderboard with `/pog leaderboard`
